svg.text: FULL CIRCUIT - 3 x 16x16 RED/GREEN - FUNCTIONAL LTspice MODEL
Rev B: physical LT-5016M1 pins / AO3401A 1=G 2=S 3=D / IREF=10k. Added default-disabled buffers, GP10 RUN_EN.
MCU/USB replaced by serial stimuli. ICs use APPROXIMATE functional models.
RED column sinks R1 / R2 / R3 - 48 channels
GREEN column sinks G1 / G2 / G3 - 48 channels
LED1 / LED2 / LED3 - 1536 individual color diodes inside the matrix subcircuits
All sixteen P-MOS row stages (100 ohm gate / 10k pull-up / extra 4n gate capacitance)
Include full_models.lib, all six ASY symbols and eight GPIO PWL files alongside this ASC. Run time: one complete 16-row scan.
